title: benchmark-prereg/1
description: The typed preregistration a benchmark gate's evidence is bound to, committed before any run it governs (GLOSSARY: Preregistration, Benchmark set, Gate, Ceiling; ADR-0010, ADR-0027). set is the gate's set: benchmark-48 (engine profiles in eval auditions over briefs of the benchmark set named by eval_set_id) or hum-benchmark (transcribers scored on hums against MIDI ground truth, with blind correction and a decision rule under which manual entry may win). It holds every part of a preregistration: the cases (each brief pinned by its content hash, or each hum with its ground truth), asset hashes, pins (subjects by profile revision and host class), budgets with the burst-run ceiling, listening quotas, coverage and exactly one threshold per protocol metric. prereg_sha256 is the sha256 of the record's canonical JSON without that field, and a reference resolves only to this kind and this set (studio_ref.binding). Nothing concludes from it yet: evidence.gates still refuses concluded benchmark and hum-benchmark records and the status fold ignores them until C02 binds a conclusion (C01). prereg/1 stays the preregistration of smoke-set eval auditions.

eval_set_id.description: benchmark-48: the benchmark set (eval-set/1) every case's brief belongs to. hum-benchmark: null.

subjects.description: Every profile revision and host class under test. An evidence record credits only its own subject.

cases.description: The exact case set, each case in its own lane; case ids are unique.

asset_hashes.description: Every seed, hum and ground truth the cases use.

budgets.description: candidates_per_brief is the equal-candidate track: each arm of each case holds exactly that many candidates (benchmark-48) or transcribed MelodySpecs (hum-benchmark).

burst_run_ceiling_usd.description: The highest ceiling any one burst run governed here may carry; never above budgets.compute_usd_cap.

cases_complete_min.description: Cases whose every arm has its jobs and its owner verdicts or corrections; at most the number of cases.

metrics.description: Every metric the decision reads; each has exactly one threshold fixed here.

committed_at.description: Strictly earlier than every job it governs.

benchmarkSet.description: The set of a profile's benchmark gate (engine-profile gates.benchmark.set).

brief_sha256.description: The sha256 of the eval-brief record's canonical JSON when committed.

ground_truth_sha256.description: The same melody played on MIDI.

decision.description: How the hum benchmark picks the default transcriber: in each lane, among the subjects allowed there that meet every threshold, the best by rank_by; when none does, manual entry wins.
